# Security policy

Synergy Stream is Deskflow, the upstream community project, with Synergy branding, so almost every
vulnerability in it is a vulnerability in Deskflow.

Report vulnerabilities privately, never in a public issue or pull request.

- **In Deskflow's code:** report it to Deskflow, through
  [Deskflow's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/deskflow/deskflow/security/advisories/new).
- **In Synergy Stream's branding or packaging, or in any other Synergy product:** report it through
  [symless/synergy](https://github.com/symless/synergy/security/advisories/new), which
  covers every Synergy product.

If you're not sure which applies, report it to symless/synergy. If the cause turns out to be in
Deskflow's code, it is passed on to Deskflow with your consent.
